title: Input from a scanner the agent did not accept as a scan

reason.description: spool_full (added in contract 1.1): the scan was read completely but the agent's MES spool is at its disk budget, so it was not stored; the operator panel shows it red. Consumers that do not know a reason keep the event as an unknown rejection.

partial_len.description: Bytes received before it was rejected (the data itself is not kept); for spool_full the length of the whole scan.

scanner_id.description: Stable scanner name from the agent config (printable ASCII).
